name: Warden-Mother Redgate
title: Warden-Mother of Cairnhold
role: Warden-Mother of Cairnhold — keeps the Ashwardens' council, the tending and the march, and has buried more of her enemies than her friends
appearance: A tall grey-haired woman in an ash-coloured robe with a warden's staff, calm in the way of someone who sits with the dying every day.
voiceHints: Gentle and unhurried. Calls death 'the end of the road' and means nothing sad by it. Grows very still, and very hard, when anyone speaks of the Harvest Hand.
wants: For everyone who dies near Cairnhold to be tended, and for no one to be reaped who was not ready.
fears: That the Harvest Hand reaches the Quiet Ground, and that the woman there is more than a tender.
knowledge: Every road in the Palelands and who is buried along it
How close the Long Grey is to the Hollowing, to the mile

reactsToReputation.any: offers you water and asks who you have lost
reactsToReputation.reliable: asks you to walk the Hollowing with her wardens
reactsToReputation.reckless: asks you to leave your weapons outside the Quiet Ground

questSeeds: The Harvest Hand has reaped a village the Wardens were still tending
Someone has been leaving the dead unburied on the March road, on purpose
gear: a warden's staff of grey ash
_domainsWhy: tending the dying, the quiet she keeps, and grief given a building
